cards.imageAlt: 机腹着陆，用于本话题的看图描述和问答
cards.taskTitle: 机腹着陆 · 看图材料

cards.referenceText:
The picture shows an airplane from Polish Airlines encountered landing gear problems, the pilot made a belly landing at last.
I can see smoke was coming from the aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh:
图片中一架波兰航空的飞机遭遇起落架故障，飞行员最后机腹着陆。
我能看到飞机有烟冒出。

cards.audioText: What may cause the landing gear problems?
cards.audioTextZh: 什么会导致飞机起落架问题？
cards.referenceText: Usually, the majority of landing gear problems are caused by hydraulic system failures.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通常情况下，起落架问题大部分是由于液压系统故障导致的。

cards.audioText: How do you determine whether the landing gears are extended or not?
cards.audioTextZh: 你如何确定起落架是否放下？
cards.referenceText:
I fly C172, our landing gear is fixed/non-retractable landing gear.
As far as I know, there are green lights indication on the panel to show the landing gear conditions.
cards.referenceTextZh:
我飞的是塞斯纳172，飞机的起落架是固定式的。
据我所知，在显示面板上会有绿灯显示起落架的状态。

cards.audioText: During approach and landing phases, when will you extend the landing gear?
cards.audioTextZh: 在进近和着陆阶段，你什么时候放下起落架？
cards.referenceText: I fly A320. In general, when the aircraft is at about 2000 feet or 10 nm from the runway, I will extend the landing gear.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我飞的是空客320，一般情况下，在高度2000英尺或者距离跑道10海里的时候，我会放下起落架。

cards.audioText: What are the functions of the aircraft landing gears?
cards.referenceText: The landing gear is used to support the aircraft and to provide steering.
cards.referenceTextZh: 起落架用于支撑飞机，以及提供飞机转向。

cards.audioText: When do you make a belly landing?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在什么情况下会进行机腹着陆？
cards.referenceText: In most cases, we perform belly landing when the landing gear is unable to release due to hydraulic failure, or when the landing gear is stuck due to foreign object.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在大部分情况下，当由于飞机液压系统出现故障，从而导致起落架无法释出，或者飞机起落架因为外物导致卡阻时，我们会执行机腹着陆。
